name: connexion-ide
description: Local Zaalis IDE with an Express server, CLI, and native Linux shell (Electron).

scripts.build:server: npm run check:mojibake && pkg . --targets node22-linux-x64 --no-bytecode --public --public-packages "*" --output native/dist-linux-server/zaalis-server
scripts.build:cli: cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release -p zaalis-cli -p zaalis-agentd -p zaalis-sandbox-helper && sh scripts/stage-rust-binaries.sh
